meta.description: The ORVIBO Door & Window Sensor works with the Zigbee Mini gateway: it shows in real time whether doors and windows are open, shuts the window when it rains and rings the doorbell when the kids get home.
meta.spec.description: ORVIBO CT10 Door & Window Sensor specifications: one CR2032 battery, Zigbee HA, IEEE 802.15.4 at 2.4 GHz, 61 × 30 × 7 mm.
ds_page.animate: It's raining, a window is open and you're away on a trip?
ds_page.animate2: Cooking in the kitchen and missing the kids coming home from school?
ds_page.animate3: A burglar breaks in: can the alarm go off right away?
ds_page.animate4: Never sure whether the fridge door is properly shut?
ds_page.animate5: Everyday hassles may need only a small change.
ds_page.dt_title: More than doors and windows: it senses what goes on all over your home
ds_page.dt_txt: With the Zigbee Mini gateway, it shows in real time whether doors and windows are open or shut. It fits more uses than you can think of.
ds_page.df_title: No more rushing home to shut the windows when it rains
ds_page.df_txt: Fit the sensor on a window and, in the ORVIBO Home app, link it to a window opener. If you see the window is open, start the opener and shut it from wherever you are. Check and control it with one tap: less time, effort and worry.
ds_page.df_title2: The kids get home, the bell rings and you know, even from the bedroom
ds_page.df_txt2: Fit the sensor on the door and, in the ORVIBO Home app, link it to a doorbell. When the kids get home from school, the bell rings and you know right away, whether you're cooking, hanging out the washing on the balcony or napping in the bedroom.
ds_page.ds_title: Fridge door left open? You'll know
ds_page.ds_txt: Fit the sensor on the fridge door too: the ORVIBO Home app shows whether it's shut, so the fridge isn't left open, wasting power.
ds_page.de_title: A little helper for a smart home
ds_page.di_txt2: Works with many devices for a fully smart home
ds_page.di_txt3: Small, to suit any style of home
ds_page.di_txt4: Detects across up to 120° and 8 m
ds_page.di_txt5: Tool-free install: peel the backing off the 3M tape and stick it on
ds_page.dn_title: Get the security kit and protect your home from every side
